formatDate.description: Formats the date displayed in the divider.

index.description: The index of the row in items.

items.description: The ids of the messages in the list, in order.

messageId.description: The id of the message this row belongs to.

shouldShowDivider.description: Decides whether the divider renders above the message, replacing the built-in rule when provided. date/previousDate are the parsed createdAt values (null when missing or invalid); previousMessage is null for the first message in the list.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

slotDescriptions.divider: The component that renders the divider.
slotDescriptions.label: The component that renders the label.
slotDescriptions.line: The component that renders the line.
